Read the audit

The full report is art/asset-audit.html. The machine inventory is sources/asset-archive-inventory.csv; it intentionally has no data rows until a real archive is audited. The audit tool can produce exact non-pixel metadata from the privately held ZIP.

What exists in this manual

The asset manifest lists planned game-facing types, Blueprint children, definitions, widgets, inputs, maps, backend contracts and test/art placeholders. It is a plan to create those assets, not evidence of existing .uasset/.umap files. Source-derived final sprite enumeration remains blocked.

Planned game assets are not compiled assets. Values are proposals unless explicitly evidenced. Verification and limitations.
